subject: Redwood x CloudBridge: marketplace listing + co-sell launch plan
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Reyna <sofia@cloudbridge.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood x CloudBridge: marketplace listing + co-sell launch plan

Hi Sofia —

Thanks again for the demo last week. CloudBridge's embedding-based search for regulated docs looks like a great fit for several of our customers. I'd love to get aligned on a practical launch plan for marketplace listing + co-sell so we can target an initial pilot with one joint customer in Q2.

Proposed next steps:
- Confirm required listing artifacts (billing SKU, product images, IaaS requirements) — Redwood can own the SKU mapping and sample pricing table.
- Share technical evidence pack (SOC2 excerpts, architecture diagram, SSO instructions) — can you send anything you already have?
- Identify the AWS/GCP contacts for listing ops and co-sell enablement — we typically need an AWS listings contact + a marketplace seller rep.
- Draft a simple MOU for co-selling responsibilities and referrals.

I'll loop in Laura (marketplace ops) and Marcus (partner engineering) for technical and contracting items. Can you propose 2x 30-min slots tomorrow or Thursday?

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198
Redwood Inference — production-first LLM inference

---
Attachment: marketplace-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Sofia Reyna <sofia@cloudbridge.io>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Adler <tom.adler@cloudbridge.io>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 11:07:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Redwood x CloudBridge: marketplace listing + co-sell launch plan

Jordan —

Appreciate the clear steps. We do have a starter bundle of artifacts: product brief, SOC2 excerpt, and an architecture diagram. Attaching the brief; I'll pull the SOC2 excerpt and SSO guide and send by EOD.

Availability: Wed 4/21 10:00am PT or Thu 4/22 9:30am PT both work for Tom and me.

For listing ops you'll want to work with AWS Marketplace (we're already a registered seller) — I can introduce our AWS Marketplace manager, and we also have a separate GCP partner contact who handles the co-sell program there if we expand beyond AWS.

Two quick asks from our side so we don't block:
1) Can Redwood provide a concise list of technical evidence you require (format + minimum items)? Marcus, could you call out the things you need?
2) We prefer the MOU to be lightweight (<2 pages) outlining lead-handling and marketing commitments. Do you have a template?

Best,
Sofia Reyna
Head of Partnerships | CloudBridge Solutions
sofia@cloudbridge.io

Attachment: CloudBridge-Solution-brief.pdf (one-page solution brief)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Reyna <sofia@cloudbridge.io>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 14:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood x CloudBridge: marketplace listing + co-sell launch plan

Sofia —

Thanks for the brief, looks good. Quick checklist from partner engineering for the technical evidence pack:
- Verified architecture diagram showing network boundaries and where customer data flows (PDF or PNG)
- SOC2 Type II summary (redacted OK)
- SAML/OIDC SSO docs and example metadata file
- Support SLA and escalation contact (email + phone)
- Minimum system requirements (GPU/CPU, memory) and recommended quantization/instance types for our Serving runtime
- Container image tag or AMI URL + test account credentials or a downloadable artifact for quick smoke tests (short-lived)

If you can provide the first four items before the call, we can pre-run an onboarding checklist and surface any additional integration work.

Jordan — I have a lightweight MOU template I use for co-sell. Laura, I'll attach a proposed MOU and the draft listing metadata for AWS (SKU name, short description, pricing band).

-Marcus
Marcus Lin
Partner Engineering | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 11:40:00 +00:00
Subject: Fwd: Redwood x CloudBridge: marketplace listing + co-sell launch plan

Looping in AWS listings ops to accelerate the SKU intake. AWS — hi, I'm Laura from Redwood's marketplace ops. We are working with CloudBridge (Sofia Reyna) on an initial AWS Marketplace listing + co-sell enablement. Attached are the draft SKU metadata and the MOU Marcus prepared.

Immediate asks for AWS listings:
- Confirm required fields and any regional constraints for the SKU.
- ETA for review of the provided artifacts (SOC2 excerpt, architecture diagram).
- Any account-level prerequisites on CloudBridge's seller profile that block public listing.

Sofia, Jordan — can you schedule the 30-min sync for Wed 4/21 10am PT (Jordan suggested) so we can run the pre-checks and identify any gaps? I'll stay on the thread to shepherd the listing request through AWS.

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
Marketplace Operations Lead | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai
